package cache

type storage struct{ items map[string]interface{} }

func (s *storage) List() []interface{} {
	result := []interface{}{}
	for _, obj := range s.items {
		result = append(result, obj)
	}
	return result
}
func (s *storage) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool)                   { obj, ok := s.items[key]; return obj, ok }
func (s *storage) ByIndex(indexName, key string) ([]interface{}, error) { return s.List(), nil }

type cache struct{ cacheStorage *storage }

func (c *cache) GetByKey(key string) (interface{}, bool, error) {
	item, exists := c.cacheStorage.Get(key)
	return item, exists, nil
}
func (c *cache) List() []interface{} { return c.cacheStorage.List() }
func (c *cache) ByIndex(indexName, key string) ([]interface{}, error) {
	return c.cacheStorage.ByIndex(indexName, key)
}
func (c *cache) Add(obj interface{}) error    { c.cacheStorage.items["key"] = obj; return nil }
func (c *cache) Update(obj interface{}) error { c.cacheStorage.items["key"] = obj; return nil }
func (c *cache) Delete(obj interface{}) error { delete(c.cacheStorage.items, "key"); return nil }
func (c *cache) Replace(list []interface{}, resourceVersion string) error {
	c.cacheStorage.items = map[string]interface{}{}
	for _, obj := range list {
		c.cacheStorage.items["key"] = obj
	}
	return nil
}
